events.title: The Raincoat Bridge
events.description: A soaked quilt bridge stretching over a ravine.

choices.text: Trade fare for threads (-12 gold, +2 scraps)

events.title: The Puppet Box Office
events.description: Rag puppets wait under a patchwork theatre awning.

events.title: The Mismatched Mittens
events.description: A merchant untangling sewn pairs of mismatched mittens.

choices.text: Trade copper for threads (-15 gold, +2 scraps)
Sell a matched pair (+18 gold, -1 scrap)

events.title: The Coil and Crow
events.description: A crow guarding a copper-coloured thread wheel.

choices.text: Buy the thread coil (-20 gold, +3 scraps)

events.title: The Patchwork Lighthouse
events.description: Fabric fog gathers around a dim stitched beacon.

choices.text: Gather threads in the fog (+1 scrap)

events.title: The Button Orchard
events.description: Brass buttons hang heavily on felt branches.

events.title: The Lacework Railway
events.description: A railway platform is suspended on braids of lace, its brass bell ringing in the fog.

choices.text: Mend a fraying platform braid (+1 scrap)
Buy a spool ticket (-18 gold, +2 scraps)

events.title: The Moonshadow Tailor
events.description: A tailor in a patched top hat fits velvet shadows beneath a button moon.

choices.text: Trade a salvaged scrap (+19 gold, -1 scrap)

events.title: The Sleeping Thimble Giant
events.description: A giant sewing thimble snores beside a sewing-table hill, spilling copper shanks.

events.title: The Needlefall Star
events.description: A falling star has pinned a silver needle through a midnight quilt field.

events.title: The Jackdaw Stitchmarket
events.description: Button-eyed jackdaws barter embroidery in a market strung between dark branches.

choices.text: Trade a spare scrap for lace (+16 gold, -1 scrap)

events.title: The Dreaming Quilt Fair
events.description: Somnolent ragdolls parade under embroidered pennants and glowing stitched lanterns.

events.title: The Blackthorn Silk Inn
events.description: A round, button-eyed innkeeper hangs moth-eaten plum blankets under the candlelit silk awning.

choices.text: Trade a spool of buttons (spend 1 scrap; gain 18 gold)

events.title: The Copper Cicada Chapel
events.description: Copper cicadas with stitched wings chime from a chapel roof of oxblood velvet.

choices.text: Buy incense-thread spools (spend 14 gold; gain 2 scraps)

events.title: The Inkglass Puppet Barge
events.description: A plump marionette ferryman guides a quilt-sailed barge through ink-black moonlit water.

choices.text: Carry stitched letters across the river (+15 gold)
Repair the quilt sail (spend 2 scraps; gain 27 gold)

events.title: The Wool-Wisp Observatory
events.description: An enormous brass telescope points through a ceiling of midnight-teal felt and floating wool stars.

choices.text: Buy three etched spools (spend 20 gold; gain 3 scraps)

events.title: The Pumpkin Pincushion Stall
events.description: A grinning pumpkin-shaped pincushion displays bent silver pins beneath a moss-green canopy.

choices.text: Trade a wound thread roll (spend 1 scrap; gain 22 gold)

events.title: The Velvet Safety-Pin Gate
events.description: Two huge safety-pin towers clasp a dusty-rose fabric gate watched by sleepy ragdoll sentries.

choices.text: Pay for gate-thread (spend 11 gold; gain 2 scraps)

events.title: The Mothlace Clock
events.description: A stitched clock ticks beneath a guttering candle, its moth-shaped hands shedding dusty lace.

events.title: The Buttonbone Aviary
events.description: Velvet-winged button-eyed birds hop along brass perches, hoarding shiny ribbons in their stitched nest.

choices.text: Trade a gilded feather (+21 gold, -1 scrap)

events.title: The Ashen Quilt Greenhouse
events.description: Needle-leaf sprouts glow through moonlit sewn glass while pale ash drifts between the quilted beds.

events.title: The Ribbon-Shadow Circus
events.description: Rag puppets cast giant shadows against a damask tent while their trailing ribbons stir the candle smoke.

events.title: The Velvet Patch Pier
events.description: A lopsided pier creaks under patchwork lanterns, its velvet planks stitched to a swelling ink-black tide.

events.title: The Lullaby Stitch Chapel
events.description: Tiny thread bells hum under moss-green stitched rafters while wax candles gutter in the draft.

choices.text: Trade for thread bells (-12 gold, +2 scraps)
